strings.Copy or move files in File Explorer. Nag: Copy or move files in File Explorer. Nagi mirrors Windows progress automatically.
strings.Keep the Windows copy/move progress dial: Keep the Windows copy/move progress dialog open. Very short transfers, command-line copies and other apps without an accessible progress dialog cannot be tracked.
strings.Notification contents stay in memory. Na: Notification contents stay in memory. Nagi does not upload them, log them or dismiss them from Windows. Focus mode suppresses external notification previews.
strings.Portable Nagi can mirror visible Windows: Portable Nagi can mirror visible Windows notification banners. Full notification history requires the packaged edition and Windows permission.
strings.Read Explorer's progress dialog without: Read Explorer's progress dialog without copying files through Nagi.
strings.Show Windows file transfers in the notch: Show Windows file transfers in the notch
strings.Show new visible Windows banners in the: Show new visible Windows banners in the notch. Works with the portable app; Windows must allow notification banners. No notification database is read.
strings.Waiting for a Windows file transfer: Waiting for a Windows file transfer
